card.name: Punctuation before numbers and section references
card.fires_on: Punctuation such as an opening parenthesis, equals sign, period or 'and' that comes right before a number or a section cross-reference. It appears in drug-label highlights and results text.

modes.label: Parenthesis before section number
modes.description: An opening parenthesis after a sentence ends, introducing a cross-referenced section number.
modes.example: Concomitant administration of BIXLENVO is contraindicated with: Dofetilide Strong CYP3A inducers.<< (>> 4 )

modes.label: Equals sign or decimal point in a measurement
modes.description: An equals sign or decimal point that leads into a numeric value such as a ratio or risk estimate.
modes.example: with an increased risk of invasive breast cancer [relative risk (RR) 0<<.>>80] 6 [see Clinical

modes.label: Parenthesis in a comparison
modes.description: A parenthesis before a percentage in a drug versus placebo comparison.
modes.example: (2%) vs. Placebo<< (<>> 1%) in clinical trials in RA

card.writes: It slightly favors words like 'against' and 'vs', which suggests a comparison or ratio is coming.
card.plain: It fires on a bracket, equals sign or period just before a number, such as a section reference or a result value.
